title: In the Lord I Take Refuge

questions.question: In the Lord I take refuge; how can you say to my soul, "Flee like a what to your mountain?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 11:1 (ESV): "In the Lord I take refuge; how can you say to my soul, 'Flee like a bird to your mountain,'"

questions.question: For behold, the wicked bend the bow; they have fitted their arrow to the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 11:2 (ESV): "...they have fitted their arrow to the string..."

questions.question: The Lord is in his holy temple; the Lord's throne is in where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 11:4 (ESV): "The Lord is in his holy temple; the Lord's throne is in heaven."

questions.question: The Lord tests the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and the one who loves what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 11:5 (ESV): "...but his soul hates the wicked and the one who loves violence."

questions.question: For the Lord is righteous; he loves what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 11:7 (ESV): "For the Lord is righteous; he loves righteous deeds;"

questions.question: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?
questions.explanation: Psalm 11:3 (ESV): "if the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?"

questions.question: His eyes see, his eyelids test the children of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 11:4 (ESV): "...his eyes see, his eyelids test the children of man."

questions.question: Let him rain coals on the wicked; fire and sulfur and a scorching wind shall be the portion of their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 11:6 (ESV): "...fire and sulfur and a scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup."

questions.question: The upright shall behold his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 11:7 (ESV): "...the upright shall behold his face."

questions.question: They shoot in the dark at the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 11:2 (ESV): "...to shoot in the dark at the upright in heart;"

questions.question: This Psalm is addressed to the Choirmaster. Who is the author?
questions.explanation: Psalm 11 Title: "To the choirmaster. Of David."

questions.question: What metaphor is used for the wicked's attack?
questions.explanation: Psalm 11:2 describes bending the bow and fitting the arrow.

questions.question: The Lord is in his holy what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 11:4 (ESV): "The Lord is in his holy temple;"

questions.question: His eyelids test whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 11:4 (ESV): "...his eyelids test the children of man."

questions.question: What happens to the one who loves violence?
questions.explanation: Psalm 11:5 (ESV): "...but his soul hates the wicked and the one who loves violence."

key_verse_text: For the Lord is righteous; he loves righteous deeds; the upright shall behold his face.
